It provides an integrated understanding of the principal functions of business and examines how organisations respond to changing markets, technologies, stakeholder expectations and competitive pressures. Students develop the ability to interpret business information, evaluate strategic alternatives and make informed decisions across areas such as people and organisations, accounting, marketing, strategy, operations and finance. The programme also encourages independent judgement, professional confidence and the ability to communicate well-reasoned recommendations in complex organisational contexts. Students follow either a three-semester or four-semester route, depending on the level and field of their previous higher education. Why choose the MBA at VUM? A cross-functional view of business: Understand how strategy, finance, marketing, operations and people management interact and influence organisational performance. Decision-making grounded in evidence: Develop the ability to analyse business information, assess alternatives and present clear, well-supported recommendations. Learning connected to organisational practice: Work with case studies, business problems, projects, presentations and analytical assignments reflecting contemporary management challenges. Preparation for broader leadership responsibilities: Strengthen the judgement, communication and professional capabilities needed to lead across teams, functions and changing organisational environments. Flexible study routes: Follow a three-semester or four-semester route according to your previous higher education. Opportunity to earn a British degree in Bulgaria : Eligible students may study towards both the VUM Master’s degree in Business Administration and the Master of Business Administration awarded by Cardiff Metropolitan University. apply online Key Facts Programme Master of Business Administration – MBA Mode of study Full-time Language of instruction English Degree awarded by VUM Master’s degree in Business Administration Study routes 3 semesters or 4 semesters, depending on the level and field of the applicant’s previous higher education International award Master of Business Administration awarded by Cardiff Metropolitan University Cardiff Met registration At the start of the applicable VUM study route, subject to meeting the relevant requirements Location Varna University of Management, Bulgaria Intakes Route September Intake February Intake 3-semester route 1.5 years / 3 semesters 1.5 years / 3 semesters 4-semester route 2 years / 4 semesters 2 years / 4 semesters *The applicable study route is determined during admission on the basis of the level and field of the applicant’s previous higher education. The three-semester route is intended for graduates in business administration, management or a related field, while the four-semester route provides additional subject preparation for graduates from other academic backgrounds. Additional optional modules may carry credits but do not count towards the required credits for the degree. Admission Requirements Admission to VUM is based on the applicant’s previous higher education, academic performance, professional profile, motivation, English language proficiency and submission of the required application documents. The three-semester route is intended for applicants with a Bachelor’s degree in business administration, management or a related field. Applicants from other academic backgrounds normally follow the four-semester route. The applicable route is determined during admission following an assessment of the applicant’s previous qualification and academic background. Admission is carried out in accordance with VUM’s admission rules and the applicable Bulgarian legislation. Additional document recognition, legalisation and translation requirements may apply depending on the country in which the previous qualification was awarded. Visa or residence requirements may also apply depending on the applicant’s citizenship and individual circumstances. Cardiff Met Degree - Key Information Students follow an integrated programme of study at VUM that meets the requirements for both the VUM Master’s degree in Business Administration and the Master of Business Administration awarded by Cardiff Metropolitan University. Eligible applicants may register for the Master of Business Administration awarded by Cardiff Metropolitan University at the start of the applicable VUM study route, subject to meeting the academic, English language, administrative and assessment requirements of both institutions. Programme delivery for a Cardiff Met degree is subject to the recruitment of a minimum cohort size. Entry Requirements The normal minimum academic requirement for Cardiff Met registration is a recognised Bachelor’s degree equivalent to at least a UK Lower Second-Class degree / 2:2. Applicants whose qualifications fall marginally below the normal requirement may, where permitted, be considered individually on the basis of relevant professional or managerial experience. Any such alternative consideration applies only to Cardiff Met academic admission or registration and does not replace the applicable VUM or Bulgarian legal, administrative, document recognition, legalisation, visa, residence or enrolment requirements. Applicants must demonstrate English language proficiency equivalent to IELTS 6.5 or above in a manner accepted by both VUM and Cardiff Metropolitan University. Accepted forms of evidence may include an approved English language certificate, confirmation that a previous degree was taught and assessed in English, or successful completion of the VUM English Language Entry Examination. Admission Policy and Procedures for Cardiff Met Programmes at VUM Credits and Final Award The Cardiff Met programme comprises 180 British credit points, including taught modules worth 140 British credit points and a 40-credit Dissertation. The Cardiff Met programme delivered at VUM includes the following modules: Module British Credit Points Managing People and Organisations 20 Accounting for Decision Makers 20 Strategic Management 20 Marketing 20 Operations Management 20 Management of Finance 20 Consumer Insights 20 Dissertation 40 Total credit points 180 Final Award: Master of Business Administration * Disclaimer: Programme structures, modules, learning activities and assessment requirements may change due to academic, regulatory, validation-related or operational reasons. VUM makes every effort to keep website information accurate and up to date; however, applicants are advised to request the latest programme information during the application process. Student Mobility VUM students may have opportunities to take part in international mobility for study or traineeships. Students may spend a semester or academic year at one of VUM’s partner universities or complete traineeships with partner employers abroad, where applicable and subject to Erasmus+ rules, VUM selection procedures, programme requirements and available funding. VUM works with more than 100 partner universities in over 20 countries and has long-standing partnerships with nearly 200 employers across Europe. During the full cycle of study, students may take part in outgoing mobilities with a combined duration of up to 12 months. Mobility opportunities must be compatible with the structure and academic requirements of the selected Master’s route. You can find detailed information about Erasmus+ study and traineeship opportunities here. Career Development The Master of Business Administration programme is designed to support advanced professional development and progression towards managerial, analytical, strategic and leadership roles across different sectors. Graduates develop a broad understanding of organisational functions and the ability to analyse complex business challenges, assess strategic alternatives, communicate recommendations and contribute to organisational development and change. Graduates of the programme may pursue careers in areas such as: general and strategic management; operations and service management; marketing, brand management and consumer insight; project and change management; human resource management and organisational development; business analysis and consultancy; innovation, digital transformation and entrepreneurship; international business and business development; public, private and non-profit sector management. Typical professional roles may include general manager, operations manager, business development manager, marketing manager, project manager, management consultant, business analyst, entrepreneur or organisational development specialist. The programme may also support experienced professionals seeking advancement into broader leadership responsibilities or a transition into a new managerial function or sector. Career progression depends on previous experience, individual performance and the requirements of the relevant employer.
